original_question: Given real vector spaces V1,...,Vd with dim(Vi)=ni+1, does there exist a tensor T ∈ V1⊗···⊗Vd such that all c(n) critical points (equivalently singular tuples in the cited setup) are real?
target_in_paper: Section 2.3, Problem 12: the open problem asking whether, for a tensor format with dim(V_i) = n_i + 1, there exists a real tensor whose full expected set of c(n) critical points (equivalently singular tuples) is defined over the real numbers.
correct_elements: Your draft is already very close to the paper’s actual target. It correctly identifies the tensor setting V1,...,Vd, the dimension convention dim(Vi)=ni+1, the existential quantifier over T ∈ V1 ⊗ ··· ⊗ Vd, and the goal that all c(n) relevant points be real. It also correctly captures the paper’s nearby equivalence between singular tuples and critical points.
missing_details: In the paper this is not a conjecture or theorem but an open problem: Section 2.3, Problem 12.
The notion of singular tuple depends on choosing an inner product on each Vi, so that each Vi is identified with Vi*.

The ambient algebraic-geometric setting of the notes is over C by default; here the question is explicitly about real vector spaces and asks whether the resulting complex critical points are all defined over R.
The symbol c(n) means c(n1,...,nd), the generic number of singular d-tuples for tensors of format (n1+1) × ··· × (nd+1), not an arbitrary count attached to a special tensor.
More explicitly, c(n1,...,nd) is the coefficient of h1^n1 ··· hd^nd in Prod_{k=1}^d (((Sum_{i != k} hi)^(n_k+1) - h_k^(n_k+1)) / ((Sum_{i != k} hi) - h_k)).
To make 'critical points' stand-alone, one should specify that they are the critical vectors of the distance function to the affine cone S_{n1,...,nd} over the Segre variety of rank-one tensors.
Equivalently, a singular d-tuple is a tuple (v1,...,vd) such that contracting T against all factors except the kth yields λvk for every k = 1,...,d.
No homogeneity, polynomial-degree restriction, or nilpotency condition belongs to Problem 12 itself; those arise only in the symmetric analogue cited for context.
refined_question: Let V1,...,Vd be real inner-product spaces with dim(Vi)=ni+1, and let S_{n1,...,nd} denote the affine cone over the Segre variety of rank-one tensors in P(V1 ⊗ ··· ⊗ Vd). Write c(n1,...,nd)=EDdeg(S_{n1,...,nd}), equivalently the generic number of singular d-tuples of a tensor of this format, i.e. the coefficient of h1^n1 ··· hd^nd in Prod_{k=1}^d (((Sum_{i != k} hi)^(n_k+1) - h_k^(n_k+1)) / ((Sum_{i != k} hi) - h_k)). Does there exist a tensor T ∈ V1 ⊗ ··· ⊗ Vd such that all c(n1,...,nd) critical points of dist_{S_{n1,...,nd}}(-,T) are defined over R?
equivalent_formulation: Equivalently, does there exist T ∈ V1 ⊗ ··· ⊗ Vd such that all c(n1,...,nd) singular d-tuples of T are defined over R, where a singular tuple means a d-tuple (v1,...,vd) for which the contraction of T against all factors except the kth equals λvk for every k=1,...,d?
justification: The draft clearly targets Section 2.3, Problem 12 rather than any other nearby problem. Its wording is already almost the same as the paper’s official formulation, but the surrounding context supplies three paper-critical pieces needed for a stand-alone version: the inner-product-dependent definition of singular tuples, the exact meaning of c(n) as the generic count from Friedland–Ottaviani, and the Section 2.4 equivalence between singular tuples and critical vectors of the distance function to the Segre cone. The refined question keeps the scope exactly at Problem 12 and does not drift into the symmetric analogue, probability tensors, or other neighboring open problems.
